# Outlier Articles

> Outlier Articles provides educational resources, guides, and news on affordable online college degrees, student success, and career development.

Outlier.org is an online education platform offering college courses and degree partnerships with institutions like Golden Gate University. The site publishes articles covering college affordability, financial aid, student success strategies, and educational partnerships with major organizations including Amazon, Google, IBM, and Salesforce.

## Key Topics

- Online Education
- College Affordability
- Degrees+ Program
- Financial Aid
- Student Success
- Transferable Credits
- Career Certificates
- FAFSA
- Associate Degree
- Student Loans
- Time Management
- Project Management
- Entrepreneurship
- Economics
- College Partnerships

## About Outlier.org

- [Outlier Articles](https://articles.outlier.org): Homepage featuring Outlier news, answers, and resources for online education.
- [6 Reasons Why Outlier.org Is Worth It](https://articles.outlier.org/is-outlier-worth-it): Overview of Outlier.org's value proposition and student testimonials.

## Degrees & College Partnerships

- [Golden Gate University & Outlier.org Reinvent Affordable College with Degrees+](https://articles.outlier.org/golden-gate-university-and-outlier-org-reinvent-affordable-college): Announcement of Degrees+ partnership between Golden Gate University and Outlier.
- [Outlier.org Partners with Amazon, Chromebook & Other Organizations](https://articles.outlier.org/outlier-org-free-college-success-course-and-partners): News about free College Success course launch with partner organizations.
- [10 Best Online Colleges Worth the Time & Money](https://articles.outlier.org/best-online-colleges): Comparison of top online colleges with costs and enrollment information.

## Financial Aid & Student Loans

- [Types of Student Loans: Which One Is Better for You?](https://articles.outlier.org/types-of-student-loans): Guide comparing federal and private student loans for college financing.
- [The Best Online Statistics Course for College Credit](https://articles.outlier.org/online-statistics-course-for-college-credit): Guide to online statistics courses and college credit options with comparisons.

## Student Success & Development

- [What's Accountability? And Why Is It Important for Students?](https://articles.outlier.org/whats-accountability): Student success guide on building accountability routines and study habits.
- [What Is Scope in Project Management?](https://articles.outlier.org/what-is-scope-in-project-management): Step-by-step guide to defining project scope and deliverables.

## Educational Content & Career Topics

- [Price Floors, Explained: A Microeconomics Tool With Macro Impact](https://articles.outlier.org/price-floors): Educational article explaining price floors and their real-world economic impact.
- [7 Types of Entrepreneurship Explained: Finding Your Best Fit](https://articles.outlier.org/types-of-entrepreneurship): Educational article exploring different entrepreneurship models and examples.
